name: Jeffrey Trefz
career_history: Preconstruction Manager at Haselden Construction, 1/2026 to present; Senior Estimator II at Haselden Construction, 6/2022 to 1/2026; Senior Estimator at Haselden Construction, 1/2020 to 6/2022; Project Estimator II at Haselden Construction, 4/2017 to 1/2020; Estimator at Pinkard Construction, 7/2013 to 11/2014; Estimator at Swinerton Builders, 7/2013 to 11/2014; Project Engineer at MATT Construction, 1/2011 to 5/2013; Estimating Intern at Intermountain Electric, 1/2010 to 7/2010; Maintenance Technician at Splash Pools, 6/2009 to 8/2009; Manager at All-Star Pools, 5/2005 to 9/2008
education: Part 107, sUAS Pilot, Pilot Institute, 2023 to present
Bachelor of Science (B.S.), Construction Management, Colorado State University, 2006 to 2010
biography:
I have extensive experience in estimating, leading and managing the preconstruction process on a variety of projects. The ground up or renovation projects I have championed include for-sale multi-family, office, government anti-terrorism/force protection buildings, higher education, museum, long term residential, hospital, health care, municipal, recreation and high-rise facilities. I complete quantity take-offs, bid analysis, buyout and accurate cost estimates for negotiated, design-build and hard-bid projects. I work directly with owners, designers, and project management (on-site) teams to develop budgets, provide systems analysis, conduct materials research, subcontractor solicitation, bid strategies and accomplish quantity surveys, pricing, cost trending, final bid assembly, bid close out, job buyout and job cost monitoring.

My experience in 5D BIM (Estimating/Costing Analysis) and 6D (Facility Data Collection) helps guide accurate conceptual estimates for quantities not yet known, scope definition, value analysis, scope verification, estimating, buyout and negotiation. I am technology focused, as I continue to pursue, research and implement 5D integration with programs such as Destini Estimator, Revit, Assemble Systems, Sage (Timberline), Innovaya and ProContractor Mx. I'm constantly searching for new and improved processes to help accelerate workflow & incorporate technology where appropriate.

In my personal time, I enjoy spending time with my family, learning and playing guitar, and fly fishing. My favorite hobby is classic car restoration, as I work to restore a car that has been in my family since 1950.
